Export a dMod Problem to PEtab

Source: R/PEtabInterface.R
exportPEtab.Rd

Writes a PEtab v1 or v2 problem to dir: the parameter, observable, condition and measurement tables, for v2 also the experiment table, an SBML model and a YAML file. Parameter scales, fixed values and per-condition values are read off the parameter transformation p.

Usage

exportPEtab(
  data,
  reactions,
  observables,
  p,
  pouter,
  errors = NULL,
  lower = NULL,
  upper = NULL,
  fixed = NULL,
  steadyState = NULL,
  events = NULL,
  parameterScale = NULL,
  observableTransformation = "lin",
  noiseDistribution = "normal",
  modelID = "dMod_export",
  formatVersion = "2.0.0",
  dir,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A datalist (or a list of data.frames keyed by condition, each with name, time, value columns; or a long-format data.frame that as.datalist() accepts). Only used for the measurements; attr(data, "condition.grid") is ignored.

reactions

An eqnlist describing the ODE network.

observables

Observable formulas keyed by observableId. Accepts a named character vector, an eqnvec, or an observation function produced by Y() (formulas read from attr(observables, "equations")).

p

A parfn produced by P(). Required: the symbolic trafo is the source of truth for parameters.tsv, conditions.tsv, and <initialAssignment> formulas.

pouter

Named numeric vector of estimated outer parameters, on the chosen parameterScale. Names become parameterIds in parameters.tsv.

errors

Noise formulas keyed by observableId. Accepts a named character vector, eqnvec, or a Y-built error function. An observable it leaves out takes the column sigma of the data. If NULL, every observable does, or has the noise "1" without that column.

lower, upper

Named numeric vectors of bounds, on the same scale as pouter. Default NULL: five decades around pouter for log and log10 parameters, -Inf and Inf for linear ones.

fixed

Named numeric vector of parameters that are not estimated, on the linear scale. Default NULL.

steadyState

The parfn of Pimpl() between p and the prediction, or NULL (default). Every condition then starts from the steady state of reactions, written as a pre-equilibration: one species per conserved total starts at the total divided by the coefficient of that species, the other states it sets at 0, and the conditions with equal parameters share one pre-equilibration condition.

events

An eventlist of the model, or NULL (default). Events at time 0 that replace a state set it in the condition table, after the pre-equilibration where there is one; their values are evaluated with the trafo of each condition.

parameterScale

NULL (default) reads the scale off p: a parameter entering only as exp(X) is "log", one entering only as 10^(X) or exp10(X) is "log10", anything else "lin". Otherwise a scalar "lin"/"log"/"log10" (broadcast to all names in pouter) or a named character vector keyed by parameterId.

observableTransformation

"lin" (default), "log" or "log10", a single value or one per observableId.

noiseDistribution

"normal" (default), "laplace" or "log-normal", a single value or one per observableId. For v2, "laplace" with a log transformation is written as "log-laplace".

modelID

SBML model identifier. Default "dMod_export".

formatVersion

"2.0.0" (default) or "1".

dir

Output directory, created if missing.

overwrite

Logical, whether existing files in dir are overwritten. Default FALSE.

Value

Path to the written YAML manifest, invisibly.

Details

An outer parameter named like a state (e.g. "A <- exp(A)") cannot share the species id in SBML. It is written as init_<state> and the condition table sets the species to it. An outer parameter named like an inner parameter keeps the name when the trafo is a pure scale wrap; for any other mapping it is written as <name>_outer.

Limitations

Events other than those at time 0 that replace a state are not written. Fixed parameters are always written with parameterScale = "lin".

See also

exportPEtabObject() for a problem returned by importPEtab(), importPEtab(); the guide chapter PEtab.

Examples

f <- addReaction(eqnlist(), from = "A", to = "", rate = "k*A")
p <- P(eqnvec(A = "exp(logA)", k = "exp(logk)"), condition = "C1",
       modelname = "petab_export_p", compile = FALSE, outdir = tempdir())
data <- datalist(C1 = data.frame(name = "y", time = 0:4, sigma = 0.1,
                                 value = c(2.1, 1.2, 0.7, 0.5, 0.3)))
yaml <- exportPEtab(data, f, observables = c(y = "A"), p = p,
                    pouter = c(logA = log(2), logk = log(0.5)),
                    dir = file.path(tempdir(), "petab_decay"),
                    formatVersion = "1")
readPEtabTables(yaml)$parameters
#>   parameterId parameterScale lowerBound upperBound nominalValue estimate
#> 1        logA            log      2e-05      2e+05          2.0        1
#> 2        logk            log      5e-06      5e+04          0.5        1
